issue_request: FHIR-30693 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ImplementationGuide change request for R5 asking to add an invariant that if ImplementationGuide.definition.page.generation is generated, ImplementationGuide.definition.page.source[x] is not allowed.
initial_application: The Jira application comment says "Git master 1fbaee7964". Commit 1fbaee7964c114b5586a1cf28405bbb77642ba8e applied FHIR-30693 together with FHIR-24649 by adding source[x] and an ig-3 invariant; commit 4590480e3217b3b115c3d9bcc1068a120dfa3f87 then corrected the expression to reference generation rather than generated.
additional_context: FHIR-24649 is the same change family because it introduced the source[x] element constrained by FHIR-30693. FHIR-I Confluence minutes record FHIR-30693 as Persuasive and later in the TSC-delayed block vote. Zulip searches found no direct FHIR-30693 discussion and no conflicting later community direction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. source/fhir.ini actively includes implementationguide=ImplementationGuide, and source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml defines ig-3 with expression generation='generated' implies source.empty(); source[x] and generation both carry condition ig-3.
